about: Shared sound effects for arcade games. Play one with ArcadeSDK.sfx(name) (see assets/arcade-sdk.js). Made with ElevenLabs sound generation on the Creator plan, which includes a commercial licence; the prompt for each sound is listed. "gain" brings every sound to about -20 dBFS RMS with the peak under -1 dBFS; ArcadeSDK.sfx applies it.
